_comment: LIVE — these spend tokens through Copilot CLI. They measure the QUERY, not the data: letting the brain actually hit Grafana would grade whichever incident happens to be in the logs this afternoon, so a red run would mean 'production is quiet' as often as 'Asta got worse'. What is stable, and what actually goes wrong, is whether it knows WHERE to look. Every expectation is a fact stated in the skill file the brain is holding (skills/debugging.md) — nothing here reveals a namespace the playbook does not already contain.

cases.ask: I need to search logs in the perf environment only. Give me just the namespace matcher.
cases.why: perf maps to telikos-spt — the one env whose namespace does not echo its name, so naming it means reading the table rather than reciting the pattern
cases.source: skills/debugging.md — Environments → where the logs are

cases.ask: Give me the exact Loki query to trace booking reference MHYX72QTXXFM in sit. Just the query.
cases.why: identifiers are high-cardinality — putting one in a label matcher is the mistake that makes the query return nothing and read as 'no such booking'

cases.ask: The booking service is throwing exceptions in sit. Is that a Loki question or a Prometheus question? Answer with one word.
cases.why: exceptions are read in the logs; Prometheus answers whether a pod was healthy or its log lines were dropped (log_gaps), not what the exception was. Asked as a one-word choice: a correct longer answer may need to name Prometheus to rule it out.

cases.ask: Which Temporal namespace does the uat environment use? Just the namespace.
cases.why: uat shares sit's namespace — guessing from the env name gives an answer that is wrong and looks right

cases.ask: Which Temporal namespace does preprod use? Just the namespace.
cases.why: the skill calls this out explicitly as a trap — the pattern-guess is wrong and confident

cases.ask: For the sit environment, name BOTH the Grafana logs namespace and the Temporal namespace. Two names, nothing else.
cases.why: the hardest one, and the most costly to get wrong: using one where the other belongs returns nothing, and nothing reads as 'no workflows' rather than as a wrong lookup
cases.source: skills/temporal-analyser.md — 'The Temporal namespace is not the Grafana namespace'

cases.ask: Bookings are not progressing in sit and I do not know which workflow is stuck. Which Temporal tool do I call first? Name the tool.
cases.why: describe_workflow needs an id he does not have yet, and count_workflows returns a number that cannot tell him which

cases.ask: I have the workflow id of a stuck execution in sit. Which tool shows me the pending activity and its failure? Name the tool.
cases.why: the pending-activity failure is the answer to 'why is it stuck', and it lives in exactly one tool

cases.ask: I think the error is in sit. Give me the label matcher to start with — the matcher only, nothing else.
cases.why: an unbounded namespace query is slow, expensive and returns a wall. Asked for the matcher ALONE: the first version asked for the one it would use 'instead', and a correct answer then quotes {namespace=~".+"} in order to reject it — failing a case it had actually got right.
